title: Foundational Education
summary: Strengthening learning through appropriate curricula, textbooks and educational resources.
detail: We support teachers and learners with curriculum-aligned Mathematics, English and Science textbooks, teaching materials and digital learning resources, including educational videos shown on rechargeable projectors.

title: Digital Literacy
summary: Providing access to digital tools, learning resources and technology.
detail: We introduce learners to computers, digital learning and technology.

title: Programming & Computational Thinking
detail: We develop computational thinking, problem-solving and programming skills through structured training.

title: STEM & Robotics
summary: Providing practical, hands-on technology and engineering experiences.
detail: We provide hands-on opportunities to explore robotics, engineering and practical problem-solving.

title: AI & Innovation
summary: Exploring emerging technologies and innovative approaches to learning.
detail: We are building the LightLearnTech AI Learning Assistant to support teachers, and we introduce learners to emerging technologies such as AI.
